title: High-Value Synthetic Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of a Compact Japanese Speech Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.00026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Private domain speech is difficult to collect and redistribute, while compact models need task-specific supervision. We study an auditable synthetic pipeline that maps Japanese care handoffs directly to six-field structured notes. Using 182 synthetic training and development clips, we adapt a 1.47B audio model by full fine-tuning and rank-16 LoRA. On a 39-clip scenario-seed-disjoint synthetic test, an unadapted model obtains a model-judged factuality-recall score of 0.0500, full tuning 0.8664, and LoRA 0.8461. LoRA reaches 97.7% of the full-tuning aggregate as a descriptive ratio while project telemetry reports 12.4M trainable parameters, about 0.85% of the backbone. Both adaptations show large paired gains over the same base; the full-versus-LoRA interval crosses zero, and differing optimization settings preclude an equivalence claim. This is a parameter-efficient capability-acquisition result, not a device-performance result: latency

translated_title: 面向紧凑型日语语音模型参数高效适配的高价值合成监督
translated_abstract: 私有领域语音难以收集和再分发，而紧凑型模型需要任务特定的监督数据。我们研究了一条可审计的合成流水线，能够将日语护理交接语音直接映射为包含六个字段的结构化笔记。使用182条合成训练与开发音频片段，我们通过全量微调和rank-16 LoRA对1.47B参数的音频模型进行适配。在一个由39条片段组成、场景与种子均互斥的合成测试集上，未适配模型的模型评判事实性召回得分为0.0500，全量微调为0.8664，LoRA为0.8461。作为描述性比率，LoRA达到了全量微调总成绩的97.7%，同时项目遥测数据显示其可训练参数仅为1240万，约占主干模型的0.85%。两种适配方式相对于同一基线均展现出较大的成对增益；全量微调与LoRA之间的置信区间跨越零，且两者优化设置不同，因此无法做出等效性声明。这是一个参数高效的能力获取结果，而非设备性能结果：延迟（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一条可审计的合成监督流水线，仅用约0.85%可训练参数的LoRA微调就能让1.47B紧凑型日语语音模型将护理交接语音转化为六字段结构化笔记，性能达到全量微调的97.7%。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an auditable synthetic supervision pipeline in which LoRA fine-tuning with only about 0.85% trainable parameters adapts a 1.47B compact Japanese speech model to convert care handoffs into six-field structured notes, achieving 97.7% of full fine-tuning performance.
